lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spot centroids are arranged in a repeating pattern of roughly parallel vertical columns and horizontal rows along the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands formed by columns of high-luminance spots intersect with horizontal alignments of smaller spots to create a grid-like structural pattern on the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible running along the dorsolateral surface, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a light-colored ridge crest and a darker shadowed region immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance circular blobs are distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, appearing most distinct along the leading edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch and loss of tissue are visible at the distal posterior margin of the lower caudal fin lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, elongated dark object is attached to the dorsal surface near the midline, positioned between the first and second dorsal fins.
